## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit; stored markup or images updated only on purpose, with the diff reviewed)
- [ ] Every new public export is documented in its declaration and in `docs/api.md`
- [ ] New charts have an example in `examples/` and a required `alt`, a data table, and no reliance on color alone
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased
- [ ] A design change has a record in `docs/design/`
